baystability: Bayesian Stability Analysis of Genotype by Environment Interaction (GEI)

Source: R/baystability-package.R
baystability-package.Rd

baystability implements the general Bayesian estimation method of linear-bilinear models of Perez-Elizalde, Jarquin and Crossa (2012) for multi-environment trials: the AMMI model and the sites regression (SREG, GGE) model, with the data of an earlier trial as the prior or with vague priors. Every parameter has a posterior distribution, so the biplot carries inference: highest posterior density (HPD) regions show which genotypes and environments interact significantly. For Bayesian stability analysis in general (Finlay-Wilkinson, Eberhart-Russell and Shukla models, stability indices, probabilities of superior performance) see the package bayesstability; for the Bayesian AMMI model of Crossa et al. (2011) see bayesammi.

Details

Functions, in the order of an analysis:

  • bys_ls_means, bys_ls_var, bys_ls_gen_effects, bys_ls_env_effects, bys_ls_ge_effects: cell means and variances, main effects, interaction effects and their singular value decomposition.

  • bys_ls_ammi, bys_ls_model: least-squares AMMI and the mixed model of the error variance.

  • bys_priors, bayes_ammi: vague priors and the Gibbs sampler, with an earlier trial as prior (.prior_data).

  • bayes_ammi_biplot: the biplot with HPD regions.

  • bys_compare: DIC and WAIC of several fits (for example numbers of terms).

  • bys_interpret, bys_cite: a plain-language interpretation and the references of a result.

  • bys_contrasts, bys_orthonormal: orthonormal contrasts and Gram-Schmidt orthonormalisation.

Every analysis returns the named list documented on its help page, with a class and methods (print, summary, plot, as.data.table); see bys-methods. Utilities: bys_theme, bys_save, bys_notation, bys_reference.

Data. cultivo2008, cultivo2009: grain yield of 12 maize hybrids in 25 environments in two years (Perez-Elizalde et al. 2012).

Vignettes. Start with vignette("baystability_01_getting_started", package = "baystability"); browseVignettes("baystability") lists all of them, each as HTML and as PDF.

Notation

Scalars are upper-case letters in normal face, indices lower-case italic, vectors lower-case bold and matrices upper-case bold. The full table is bys_notation().

\(G\), \(E\), \(B\), \(K\)numbers of genotypes, environments, replicates, bilinear terms
\(\mathbf{Y}\), \(\mathbf{Y}_0\)tables of cell means of the trial and of the earlier trial
\(n_0\)weight (replicates) of the earlier trial
\(\mu\), \(\boldsymbol{\tau}\), \(\boldsymbol{\delta}\)overall mean, genotype and environment effects
\(\lambda_k\), \(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_k\), \(\boldsymbol{\gamma}_k\)singular value and genotype and environment score vectors of term \(k\)
\(\sigma^2\)error variance

References

Perez-Elizalde, S., Jarquin, D. and Crossa, J. (2012). A general Bayesian estimation method of linear-bilinear models applied to plant breeding trials with genotype x environment interaction. Journal of Agricultural, Biological, and Environmental Statistics, 17(1), 15–37. doi:10.1007/s13253-011-0063-9

Crossa, J., Perez-Elizalde, S., Jarquin, D., Cotes, J. M., Viele, K., Liu, G. and Cornelius, P. L. (2011). Bayesian estimation of the additive main effects and multiplicative interaction model. Crop Science, 51(4), 1458–1469. doi:10.2135/cropsci2010.06.0343
